performance.percentile_boundary: Nearest-rank percentiles describe these samples only. With fewer than 100 samples, P99 selects the maximum; small windows do not establish a stable tail-latency estimate.
performance.measurement_boundary: Actual Godot _process intervals in the Android emulator; per-window percentiles are not global percentiles or display presentation timestamps.
performance.audio_boundary: Accepted native playing/audible status; no human listening or acoustic waveform capture.

system_rendering_evidence.interpretation: Supplementary raw Android reports. HWUI gfxinfo can omit Godot SurfaceView rendering; SurfaceFlinger latency can be unsupported. Neither substitutes for the measured native frame windows.
